decisive_items: anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody of 237.39 units (normal <20 units)
response.rationale: The patient's symptoms and laboratory results, including positive rheumatoid factor and anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide antibody, are consistent with Rheumatoid Arthritis.

rejected.why: Negative extractable nuclear antigen and double-stranded DNA antibodies make Systemic Lupus Erythematosus less likely
Lack of other symptoms or laboratory findings specific to Post-COVID-19 Reactive Arthritis
Undifferentiated Connective Tissue Disease is less likely due to the presence of specific antibodies for Rheumatoid Arthritis
